The color depth in bits per pixel of what a display shows right now, usually 24 or 32. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.
@param display  The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays).
@returns The depth in bits, or 0 if the display does not exist.
@gap A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
